Registry of 12 dims at source/index.html:218-231; unbounded/dense shape handled via scrollable tiles and top-200 table (index.html:456).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Dimension exploration dominates the initial screen in both viewports: left rail of 12 clickable dimensions, center stage headed '当前投影' with measure segmented control, and rail footer stating the interaction model '点击维度 = 切换投影' (index.html:403). The success criterion is advertised on-screen via the '跨维保留：选中 0 · 过滤 0 维' pill (index.html:412).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Grid 238px/1fr/316px with topbar, dimension rail, stage (projhead+cogbar+tiles+table), and 4-section ledger (index.html:39). Density matches the brief's high-density/high-dimensionality shape and the ledger is required by the seed, but at initial state the right ledger is mostly empty hints ('无过滤…', '选择集 0', screenshot right panel) yet permanently occupies 316px — proportionate, slightly more chrome than strictly needed at first paint.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 3 of 4 a11y-related checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, plus type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json). Consistent with source: CSS defines :hover but no :focus-visible styles (index.html:48-50, 55-61, 83-97), 10-11px type throughout (:59-60, :93, :104), compact targets (seg buttons padding 3px 9px :72, chip ✕ :126). Credit for real effort: tiles have role=button/tabindex/Enter (:440, :546), rail/chips are semantic buttons, aria-labels on asides (:161, :176), toast role=status (:178) — but detail-table rows are click-only with no keyboard path (:462).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass, target_invalid=false (measurement-summary.json); both viewports render cleanly (1440x900 simply fits a 4th value tile). But 4 of 7 checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), a substantial defect surface implying a rework pass even though it is a11y/type rather than layout breakage.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '过滤/投影状态有归属且可回退' is fully covered and visible on first screen: every mutation commits a snapshot with label+source+time (index.html:306-312); ledger shows projection attribution '来源：系统 · 02:32:29' (:480-481), filter bookkeeping '每条含来源+时间' with per-value single removal (:483-491), snapshot history click-to-restore (:505-510), plus undo/redo/reset/time-travel (:313-325) and drill recorded as revertible filter (:367-371). Right panel in both screenshots shows '过滤版本 0 · 每条含来源 + 时间' and '快照历史 #1 初始状态 基线'.

No :focus-visible styles defined anywhere in the stylesheet (source/index.html:7-147)

scores.overall_note: impl-19 is a single-file, statically-openable projection explorer that matches the brief's explore×dimensional-space job almost point for point: 12 registered dimensions (source/index.html:218-231), one-click projection switching with selection/filter/focus retained across switches (:287-293, :351, :419-423), and a state ledger that gives every filter/projection change attribution (source+time) and four independent revert paths (undo, redo, reset, snapshot time-travel; :306-325, :483-510), which fully covers the acceptance seed and is already visible on the first screen in both viewports. Layout is defect-free per receipt (layout.overflow/responsive_collision/text.truncation all pass) and both screenshots confirm clean rendering at 1280x860 and 1440x900 with data ready at first paint and no loading state. The clear weakness is accessibility: three a11y checks plus the minimum-type check fail, consistent with hover-only styling, keyboard-inaccessible table rows, and pervasive 10-11px text, despite genuine affordances (role=button tiles with Enter support, aria-labels). This model-judged review cannot speak to human preference, task time, or retrieval accuracy; scores reflect only screenshots, sanitized receipt, and source.
